detected_by: Attributing every 'test result: FAILED' line back to its 'Running' line in the run's own log, then re-running the two suites with PCGEN_REPO_DIR set to a HOME-relative path and observing them pass
impact: SD-27's own per-book parity gates (tests/sd27_advanced_race_guide_parity.rs, tests/sd27_pathfinder_unchained_parity.rs) reported '0 passed; 1 failed' on every verification sweep for the entire tranche, so the ARG and PU parity claims shipped through planning unverified. Corpus, fixtures and PCGen were all present and correct throughout; a single const in src/oracle_validation/pcgen_runner.rs pointed at another machine's home directory and PcgenRunOptions::new routes both suites through it.
resolution: HOME-relative defaults across tests/, src/, scripts/ plus tests/no_foreign_home_paths.rs as a regression guard; both suites now pass with no env vars set (14 of 15 dimensions matching each, against real PCGen 6.09.08.RC1 runs)
summary: Both SD-27 per-book parity gates never executed during the whole tranche; the books' parity proof was unverified until now
